title: RoAR-VAE: Improving Latent Diffusability through Robust Prediction
title_zh: RoAR-VAE：通过鲁棒预测提升潜变量可扩散性

paragraphs.en: 总结：文章提出RoAR-VAE视觉分词器，通过损坏潜变量的鲁棒预测目标提升重建保真度与下游扩散模型的可学习性。 An effective visual tokenizer must preserve image fidelity while producing latents that downstream diffusion models can learn efficiently. Prior work improves latent diffusability through semantic alignment or joint tokenizer--diffusion training. Revisiting REPA-E, a representative approach, we find that removing its diffusion objective and dedicated generative blocks while retaining semantic prediction from corrupted latents yields comparable downstream generation performance under a matched setting. This observation motivates a general principle of robust prediction: generation-relevant information should remain recoverable from corrupted latents. We instantiate this principle with two complementary objectives. RobustAlign predicts pretrained semantic features from corrupted latents to preserve high-level structure, while RobustRecon reconstructs the clean image to retain fine-grained spatial and appearance information. Together, they form Robust Alignment and Reconstruction VAE (RoAR-VAE). Our analysis suggests that robust prediction improves diffusability by making useful information more accessible in high-variance latent directions, which diffusion models tend to learn earlier. Empirically, RoAR-VAE improves average generation benchmark performance by 2.19 points over the strongest baseline tokenizer under the same training budget, while improving small-text reconstruction accuracy by 16.93 percentage points over FLUX.1-VAE. These results demonstrate that RoAR-VAE achieves a favorable balance between reconstruction fidelity and downstream generative learnability.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：文章提出RoAR-VAE视觉分词器，通过对损坏潜变量的鲁棒预测目标提升重建保真度与下游扩散模型的可学习性。一个有效的视觉分词器必须在保持图像保真度的同时，生成下游扩散模型能够高效学习的潜变量。 已有工作通过语义对齐或分词器与扩散模型联合训练来提升潜变量的可扩散性。 通过重新审视REPA-E这一代表性方法，我们发现，在保留从损坏潜变量进行语义预测的同时，去除其扩散目标和专用生成模块，在匹配设置下也能获得相当的下游生成性能。 这一观察启发了一个通用的鲁棒预测原则：与生成相关的信息应当能够从损坏潜变量中恢复出来。 我们用两个互补的目标来实例化这一原则。 RobustAlign从损坏潜变量预测预训练的语义特征以保留高层结构，而RobustRecon重建干净图像以保留细粒度的空间与外观信息。 两者结合构成鲁棒对齐与重建变分自编码器（RoAR-VAE）。 我们的分析表明，鲁棒预测通过使有用信息在扩散模型倾向于更早学习的高方差潜变量方向上更易获取，从而提升可扩散性。 实验表明，在相同训练预算下，RoAR-VAE相比最强的基线分词器将平均生成基准性能提升了2.19分，同时相比FLUX.1-VAE将小字重建准确率提升了16.93个百分点。 这些结果表明，RoAR-VAE在重建保真度与下游生成可学习性之间取得了良好的平衡。
